component.name: Race Into Space
component.summary: Run a national space programme and race to land on the Moon

description.p: A remake of the 1993 space-race strategy game. Direct the United States, the Soviet Union or a British-led Commonwealth programme from 1957 to 1977: buy rockets and capsules, research them until they are safe to fly, recruit and train crews, plan missions step by step and watch every launch play out. The first side to land a crew on the Moon and bring them home wins.

ul.li: Three space programmes with their own hardware, spaceports and politics
62 mission types, from the first satellite to the lunar landing
Every flight animated, showing the vehicle you are actually flying
Play against the computer or hot-seat with friends
Colour-blind friendly colours, keyboard play and a scalable interface

description.p: First packaged build: three programmes, hot-seat play, full art.
